neededItems.name: Access to the air, water, earth, and fire altars

recommendedItems.name: Extra dramen staves (for more lunar staves)

steps.title: Starting out
steps.text: Talk to Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's westernmost dock.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: You've been away from these parts a while?

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue talking to Lokar Searunner.
Buy a spade from Sigmund the Merchant.

steps.title: Getting to the isle
steps.text: Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage.
steps.warning: Keep the seal on you throughout the quest.

actions.text: Ask about a seal of passage.

steps.text: Return and talk to Lokar.

actions.text: Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!

steps.text: Climb the ladder.
Talk to Captain Bentley.

actions.text: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?

steps.text: Climb down the ladder.
Talk to 'Bird's-Eye' Jack to the south.
Climb up the ladder.
Talk to Captain Bentley again.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
Climb up the ladder.
Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front of the ship.
Climb down the ladder.
Climb down the ladder again.
Talk to 'Beefy' Burns in the kitchen.
Climb up the ladder.
Climb up the ladder again.
Climb up the ladder yet again.
Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy'.
Climb up the ladder.
Talk to the cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required).
Use the lens on the lantern. Light it.
Climb down the ladder.
Use the lantern on the wallchart in the captains quarters.
Climb down the ladder.
Use the lantern on the cannon.
Climb down the ladder.
Use the lantern on the chest.
Use the lantern on the support.
Use the lantern on the barrel.
Climb up the ladder.
Climb up the ladder again.
Talk to Captain Bentley.

steps.title: Lunar Isle
steps.text:
Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cutscene).
  • You can use the bank if you have seal of passage.

Go north-east outside the city and kill suqahs until these items are obtained:
  • One suqah tooth.
  • 4 suqah hides.
  • If not already in the backpack, one grimy guam and one grimy marrentill. Clean the herbs.
Climb down the ladder into the mine.

Mine a stalagmite.
  • Optional: Mine the Rune Essence rcok to complete the Hard Fremennik achievement 'Runes on the Moon'.
Exit the mine.
Talk to the Oneiromancer near the astral altar at the south-east part of the island.
Go inside the walking house in the northern section of the city.
Talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required).

actions.text: The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...

steps.text: Use the vial on the sink.
Use a clean guam on the vial of water.
Use a clean marrentill on the guam vial.
Grind the suqah tooth.
Use the ground suqah tooth on the guam-marr vial.
Leave the house.
Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.

steps.title: Lunar staff
steps.text: Order matters. Use your dramen staff/staves on the air altar.
Use your dramen staff/staves on the fire altar.
Use your dramen staff/staves on the water altar.
Use your dramen staff/staves on the earth altar.
Smelt the lunar ore at any regular furnace.
Make a lunar helmet at a regular anvil.
'Travel' from Lokar Searunner in Rellekka at the westernmost dock
Climb up the ladder.
Travel with Captain Bentley.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to the Oneiromancer to give her a lunar staff.

steps.title: Lunar gear
steps.text: Talk to Pauline Polaris in the north-western-most building in the city.
Talk to Meteora south in the city.
Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara.
Give Meteora the tiara.
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis in the clothing store south of the bank about ceremonial clothes.
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides.

actions.text: That seems like a fair deal.

steps.text:
Craft a lunar torso, trousers, gloves, and boots from your hides.
  • You can buy thread from Rimae's shop.
Talk to Selene next to the lodestone.
Dig on the marked tile south of the city.
Talk to the Oneiromancer.

steps.title: Getting ready for bed
steps.text: Use the vial on the kindling.

Get ready for the next sections. Manually move to the next step when you're ready.
  • Equip ALL lunar gear.
  • Get your combat runes (prioritize fire spells) and supplies.
  • Dismiss your follower
  • Wear all your lunar items.
  • Four backpack spaces are required.
  • Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack to avoid a bug later in the quest.
Light the ceremonial brazier in the building west of the lodestone.

Use the soaked kindling on the brazier.
  • If you exit the Dreamworld early, you can get a new kindling from the Oneiromancer.

steps.title: Dicing
steps.text: Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Step on the yellow/green platform south-west of the island.
Talk to Ethereal Fluke.

He will call out a number. You need to make the dice add up to the number he called. When you 'roll' one of the dice, it will turn the die upside down, so each die only has two possible numbers (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4).

steps.title: Number sequence
steps.text: Head south-east and step on the pink/purple platform.
Talk to Ethereal Numerator.

Click on the numbers to complete the patterns for four times.

steps.title: Logging race
steps.text: Head north-east and step on the blue platform.

Talk to Ethereal Perceptive.
  • Bug: Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet or you will have to leave to bank it.
Run west.
Run west and chop 20 dream logs, depositing them on your log pile.
Deposit your logs.
Wait to be be teleported back to the middle plaform.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

steps.title: Memorisation
steps.text: Head north-west and step on the grey platform.
Talk to Ethereal Guide.
Cross the chasm by jumping on the correct combination of Dream Puffs. Keep a note of the correct steps! You can use the table on the wiki to track them.
Wait to be be teleported back to the middle plaform.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

steps.title: The hurdles
steps.text: Head east and step on the yellow platform.
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race.
Jump over the hurdles. If you fail three times, you will lose the race. Run and stop before each hurdle, before clicking the orb to jump over.
Wait to be be teleported back to the middle plaform.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

steps.title: Copy cat
steps.text: Head south and step on the green platform.
Talk to Ethereal Mimic.

actions.text: Suppose I may as well have a go.

steps.text: Click on them and then copy the emote that they perform. They teleport after each correct emote.
Wait to be be teleported back to the middle plaform.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

steps.title: Fight Me
steps.text: Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady to begin the final fight.

Kill Me. You can safe-spot them behind the dream tree.
  • Should you forget your runes after entering the fight, you will not be able to leave the fight in any way unless you log out and back in. This will take you back to Lunar Isle where you can bank to get the runes.
  • Be sure to equip your Seal of passage before speaking to a banker.
  • Go back to the Oneiromancer again to get the kindling and potion to return back to the dream.
  • Re-equip your Lunar amulet before attempting to enter the dream.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle.
Talk to the Oneiromancer.
